name: coordinate-codex-agents
description: Coordinate Codex app tasks across saved local and remote projects using host-provided Codex app task-management tools.

interface.longDescription: Find, inspect, create, message, and open Codex app tasks across saved projects. Confirm the communication target before starting an outbound exchange and use each delegated project's agent as its exclusive implementation interface. Requires host-provided Codex app task-management APIs.
defaultPrompt: Use Coordinate Codex Agents to find the chats for my saved backend project.
Use Coordinate Codex Agents to ask another project's agent a question after I choose its chat.
